_what_this_is: Azure region -> default AWS region. Consumed by design-refs/index.md's region handling and by Clarify's global.target_region default.
_selection_rule: Nearest AWS region by geography, preferring the same country where one exists and the same regulatory bloc otherwise. This is a DEFAULT, not a determination.
_override: global.target_region in preferences.json ALWAYS wins. A customer with a data-residency obligation, an existing AWS footprint, or a latency requirement has a reason this table cannot see.
_residency_warning: Several Azure regions have no AWS region in the same country. Where _same_country is false, the move crosses a border, and that can breach a residency commitment the customer has made to their own customers. Emit a warning; never resolve it silently.
_provenance: Authored from published region geographies. Region availability changes; verify the target region offers the services in the design before committing. Azure region names were checked against Microsoft Learn's list of Azure regions, and AWS Region codes and opt-in status against AWS's Region list, on 2026-11-19.

brazilsoutheast.geo: Rio de Janeiro -> Sao Paulo, Brazil
brazilsoutheast.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for Brazil South, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access.

chilecentral.note: No AWS region in Chile. Sao Paulo is the nearest, about 2,600 km away, so expect more latency than for any other mapping in this file.

mexicocentral.note: AWS Region mx-central-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

westeurope.note: No AWS region in the Netherlands. eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) is the alternative and is often the better latency choice for Dutch and German users.

francesouth.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for France Central, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access.

germanynorth.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for Germany West Central, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access.

switzerlandnorth.note: AWS Region eu-central-2 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

switzerlandwest.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for Switzerland North, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access. AWS Region eu-central-2 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

norwaywest.note: No AWS region in Norway. Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for Norway East, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access.

austriaeast.note: No AWS region in Austria. eu-central-2 (Zurich) is about as close but is an opt-in Region; Frankfurt is enabled by default.

belgiumcentral.note: No AWS region in Belgium. Paris is the nearest; London and Frankfurt are each about 320 km away.

uaenorth.note: AWS Region me-central-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

qatarcentral.note: No AWS region in Qatar. AWS Region me-central-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

uaecentral.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for UAE North, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access. AWS Region me-central-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

saudiarabiaeast.note: No AWS region in Saudi Arabia. Bahrain is about 56 km from Dammam; the next nearest, me-central-1 (UAE), is about 540 km away. Azure lists this region as in preview. AWS Region me-south-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

israelcentral.note: AWS Region il-central-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

southafricanorth.note: AWS Region af-south-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

southafricawest.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for South Africa North, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access. AWS Region af-south-1 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

indiasouthcentral.note: AWS Region ap-south-2 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

southeastasia3.note: Azure lists this region as in preview. Same-country default; Singapore (ap-southeast-1) is only about 20 km away if latency matters more than keeping data in Malaysia. AWS Region ap-southeast-5 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

malaysiawest.note: AWS Region ap-southeast-5 is an opt-in Region: the account must enable it before use.

australiacentral2.note: Azure restricts access to this region to specific customer scenarios such as disaster recovery for Australia Central, so it appears in an inventory only when the customer was granted access.

newzealandnorth.note: AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand), ap-southeast-6, GA since 2025-09-30. Same-country default; confirm the specific services needed are available there and the account has opted in, otherwise fall back to ap-southeast-2 (Sydney).

chinanorth3.note: Azure China is operated by 21Vianet under a separate tenant and separate ARM endpoints. AWS China (Beijing / Ningxia) is likewise operated separately and requires its own account and ICP filing. This is NOT a region mapping -- it is a separate migration with its own legal entity work. STOP and say so.

usgovvirginia.note: Azure Government to AWS GovCloud. Separate partition, separate credentials, and compliance scope carries over rather than being re-derived.

_unlisted_region: Resolve by geography from the Azure region's published location, prefer the same country, and record sizing_provenance-style honesty: state that the region default was derived rather than looked up. Never invent an AWS region name -- an invalid region makes every downstream price wrong and the Terraform unapplyable.
